jobs.prompt:

```bash
cd ~/.hermes
git pull || { echo "ERROR: git pull failed"; exit 1; }
git push || true
git add -A
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "hermes STEA CRMMIAM02 VIRTUAL_MACHINE_UID=906 backup: $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S')"
else
  git commit --allow-empty -m "hermes STEA CRMMIAM02 VIRTUAL_MACHINE_UID=906 backup: $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S')"
```

jobs.name: MIAM-00112 PCIe/ECC watchdog
jobs.prompt: Run the MIAM-00112 PCIe/ECC error monitor and report any NEW flag. Execute: source the script at ~/.hermes/profiles/agent_stea004_entrepreneur/scripts/miam_pcie_watch.sh. This script SSHes to 10.0.20.112 and runs /usr/local/sbin/miam_pcie_monitor.sh which emits output ONLY when the PCIe/ECC/Xid/AER/GPU-presence/link state changed since the last check. If the script prints a report, that means a new flag appeared — forward it to the user as an alert, highlighting anything that could indicate PCIe slot / CPU pin high-impedance (Xid errors, link-width drops, uncorrectable ECC, missing GPUs, AER errors). If the script produces no output, stay silent (healthy). Do not fabricate results; only report real script output.
